title: Implement RTH filtering utility
objective: A reusable RTH filter function removes bars outside regular trading hours (09:30-16:00 ET, Mon-Fri) from any wide-format DataFrame

functions.name: is_rth
functions.returns: True if timestamp falls within RTH

functions.name: get_rth_minutes
functions.returns: List of all RTH minute timestamps for a given date

acceptance_criteria: filter_rth removes after-hours bars (at or after 16:00 ET)
filter_rth preserves bar at exactly 09:30 ET
filter_rth removes bar at exactly 16:00 ET (last bar is 15:59)
Input DataFrame with UTC index is handled correctly
Returns DataFrame with same column structure
Empty DataFrame input returns empty DataFrame
get_rth_minutes returns exactly 390 timestamps for a trading day
non_goals: Holiday calendar (treat holidays as regular weekdays for now)
